matching_conditions: same selected source terms and deletion
same 100000 conflict budget; individual wall budgets recorded
scope: paired local frozen-patch experiment only; no global rank nonexistence claim
timing_assumptions: elapsed_seconds is solve_local wall time including child startup and solver initialization; excludes encoding and source ingestion
workers run concurrently on separate pinned CPU cores under root harness; wall ratios are empirical, not normalized CPU benchmarks
only complete solve records in both logs are joined; any interrupted or unpaired work is excluded
CNF hashes differ because the lexicographic symmetry constraints differ; equal patch identity describes the same local residual tensor
